newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices gain, buying ahead of festival.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices gain, buying ahead of festival.

text.p: Indian sugar prices gained on Thursday on increased consumer buying ahead of the weekend Diwali festival, dealers said.
They said sugar quality supplied through the public distribution system was inferior and consumers returned to the open market for festival buying.
Ready delivery S-30 sugar rose by five rupees to 1,295/1,325 rupees while M-30 moved up by 5/8 rupees to 1,328/1,365. Sugar mill delivery rose by 10/20 to 1,200/1,220.
"Higher outstation buying at mill level has curtailed sugar arrivals from mills to the local market," one dealer said.
